name: Abyssal Apocrypha
storyline:
The old antediluvian passages were correct... The ancients lie dreaming... waiting for their reawakening...

We heard the call: Like a piercing whisper commanding us to dance against our will. Dragging our feet to the edge of the precipice, we burned our eyes, looking at their otherworldly presence.

Now, blind with madness, we stumble in the dark abyss, trying to find a way out.
summary: Abyssal Apocrypha is an MBF21 project inspired by the "Lovecraft Mythos". Explore Jungles, Caves, Temples, Old Cities, Houses, laboratories, and uncover the secrets of the old gods in this 24-map-long adventure.
